Meaning

Rule
rows: every cell holds one (atomic) value; no repeating groups

items: Anomalies of a badly designed table: insertion, deletion, update (modification).

Referential integrity: each foreign key value matches an existing primary key (or is null).
Functional dependency X → Y: one X value fixes one Y value (RollNo → Name).
